input.free_text_description: This system is a social platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user, product. The platform provides capabilities for user client, item. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with item functionality, so that I can accomplish my item-related tasks.
